UNDERSTAND YOUR OPTIONS

Drain Clearing

01

One fixture or the whole house?

A single slow sink may point to a local blockage. Several affected fixtures can suggest a restriction farther along the drainage system. Share which drains are affected.

02

Kitchen and bathroom blockages

Grease and food residue restrict kitchen drainage. Hair, soap buildup, and objects obstruct bathroom drains. Line location and condition guide the clearing method.

03

When the clog comes back

Repeated blockages deserve investigation. Ask whether a camera inspection could help locate buildup, roots, or damage rather than repeating the same process.

SERVICE QUESTIONS

Good questions. Useful answers.

Should I keep running water into a backed-up sink?+

Stop using the fixture so water does not overflow. Call to discuss symptoms and next steps.

Why does the same drain keep clogging?+

Recurring clogs can reflect buildup, an object, or an issue farther along the line. Clearing and inspection address different parts of diagnosis.
